episode.episode_title: Alibaba’s AI roadmap: models, chips and 20GW of cloud capacity
episode.episode_description: Alibaba has outlined plans for a 5-to-10-trillion-parameter model, more than 20GW of cloud data-centre capacity by 2032 and a new in-house accelerator. This episode separates the roadmap from what has already been delivered.

selected_story.headline: Alibaba outlines 5T–10T parameter model and 20GW cloud target
selected_story.source_title: Alibaba CEO Eddie Wu says the company plans to train a 5T- to 10T-parameter AI model, as it lays out a sweeping push across AI models, chips, and data centers (Reuters)

short.title: Alibaba outlines 5T–10T parameter model and 20GW cloud target
short.description:
The announcement shows Alibaba investing across models, custom accelerators and cloud infrastructure at the same time. The targets are a roadmap rather than delivered capacity, and Alibaba says supply constraints remain a challenge.
